about: Every friction a person meets in the apps, in our own words: where, what happened, the fix, and its state. Principle ask-by-frequency (owner, 2026-11-11). The number of open items only goes down; governance/tests/test_frictions.py holds the shape.

frictions.friction: Editing the profile showed no children or loans, and saving erased them, so the Kids tab asked for the child again
frictions.fix: Setup reloads children and loans when editing (PR 233)

frictions.friction: Asked again for take-home, gross, spending, savings, investments, birth month and retirement age
frictions.fix: Reads the profile and writes an edit back (PR 233)

frictions.friction: Asked again for ages, income, net worth and emergency fund
frictions.fix: Derives ages from birth dates and reads money from the profile (PR 233)

frictions.friction: An empty 'Add your child' form beside the children already saved
frictions.fix: The add form is folded under 'Add another child' (PR 233)

frictions.friction: Updating one changing number (investments) meant scrolling past name, birth date, city and family every time
frictions.fix: Editing the profile folds name, birth date, place, family and vision under two lines that show them; the money fields stay in view (test43)

frictions.friction: No quick way to update the numbers that change (investments, savings, spending, loan balance) without opening the whole set-up
frictions.fix: A 'My numbers' card on Money and the Life Map: investments, savings, spending, take-home, saved to the profile with 'updated N days ago'; Career and the Life Map follow (test43). The monthly cue is the existing Money Date ritual

frictions.friction: Ages that come from birth dates still show as fields to type
frictions.fix: Ages from birth dates show as text with 'from your profile' (test43)

frictions.where: Life OS, Ops (Who touched my data)
frictions.friction: A backup saved the whole life as a readable file in Downloads, and the log screen showed a terminal command and a cramped four-column table on a phone
frictions.fix: Backups are encrypted by default with a backup phrase made once and kept on the device (shown once, in Settings any time); restore on a new device with the phrase; a readable copy only by name and flagged in red with what to delete; the log reads as plain rows with no command (test44, threat model lifeos-backup)

frictions.where: Life OS, Ops (CSV, spouse emergency page)
frictions.friction: The Excel (CSV) export and the spouse emergency page are still readable files
frictions.fix: Both are readable on purpose (for Excel, for a spouse in an emergency); show a one-line warning and log them in Who touched my data; consider a print-only emergency page
